reviews.text: You have to go to Spar.
Great place, the salesgirl is very kind and helpful.

Damn, they really should have written that you have to go into the underpass to the Spar area. Not into the store, just through the door, and there on the right is the alpha zoo.
So I found it only after half an hour of useless searching 😩😩😩😩😩👺

The store is in a pretty hard to find location, and I also came here because I saw online that they finally had not only dog ​​and cat supplies but also rodent supplies. In comparison, I was unfortunately disappointed in this store, but the salesperson was very kind and helpful.
I couldn't find the store. It's not where the GPS position shows. I walked around that area twice. There's not a sign or sign anywhere. 🙁 …
Unfortunately, it is still not possible to change opening hours in 2024. It would be 1 click and people would not need to go to the store location unnecessarily.
The blond guy who served me was very nice and polite. Considerate and helpful.

If I remember correctly, I went into the store on the West Square on Monday (you can find it "inside" Spar, the store is on the right). A young man with a bull terrier tattoo served me, he was very nice, he also noticed my bull terriers. The point is that I bought the Ontario senior mini 7 fish & rice food for my dachshund and after a few days I dare to say that the transition was absolutely smooth, the kaki is very nice, and Mia loves it too, although she didn't eat the Acana horse food back then (the child is a bit finicky :)). So far we have been using Select Gold senior, but now we will switch to this, as I have read it is a similar quality food, and the price is similar, and the company is Slovenian, if I read correctly.
Thank you very much for your help.
nice place, check the underground level near the spar
